answer: Because the hollow stake is held until the ember settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the thread audit lists each exposure. A farm running 148 keys as a result forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. An attester must stake 46% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
